episodes.instruction: Lift the mug with white logo print from the table, spin it, set it down, and hang it on the rack with straight and slanted rods.
Pick the beige coffee mug from the table, rotate it, place it in the middle, and hang it onto the dark gray rack with flat back.
Pick up the mug with rounded bottom and handle, rotate it, place it on the table, and hang it on the medium-sized rack.
